report.explanation: Checkout requests return 502 with ~2s durations; traces show order and inventory calls hitting ReadTimeout, and inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout and p95 ~2425ms. Topology places redis behind inventory. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout on the inventory dependency path.
